rhymes.title: Head, Shoulders, Knees, Toes
rhymes.content: Learning Goal: To build auditory skills, introduce body part recognition, and develop gross motor coordination. Activity: Rhyme introduction and physical movement. Detailed procedure: The teacher leads the students in singing the rhyme 'Head, Shoulders, Knees, and Toes' slowly. As each body part is named, the teacher demonstrates touching the corresponding area (head, shoulders, knees, toes), encouraging the children to follow along and physically engage with the song to build physical vocabulary connections.

stories.title: The Tortoise And The Rabbit
stories.content: Learning Goal: To introduce narrative listening, build attention span, and understand character contrast. Activity: Storytime reading and character introduction. Detailed procedure: Read the story 'The Tortoise and the Rabbit' aloud to the class. Introduce the two main characters, highlighting their differences: the rabbit who ran fast and was very proud, and the tortoise who walked very slowly. Describe the setting of the forest and the challenge of the race.
